detail: check-then-write pre-creates raced across processes and clobbered committed data; WAL serializes statements but not read-modify-write pairs; waiters gave up (ELOCKED) before proper-lockfile's stale window allowed stealing a dead process's lock.
summary: Cross-process write-safety fixes from the multiwriter soak: exclusive-create (O_EXCL) for all file pre-creates, BEGIN IMMEDIATE around every sqlite read-modify-write, and lock retry budget (~24s) rais
